event.description:
Capped at 32 players. Registration is First come first serve after payment made and verified, payment to be made to secure your slot. After apply on Omnidex, please message us on telegram/FB/IG to check on availability and make payment. 

Format: BO3, up to 5 rounds depends on turnout
Entry $20 include:
- 3 HVN Booster packs & 1 Stamp Dormouse Informant Promo.

Prizes for top ranking players:
Champion: 1 Crystallized Destiny Invite Card + 1 Store Champ Playmat.
Top 8: 2 PTM Event Pack each. 

To register for this event, apply on Omnidex, join our telegram group, message us on IG/FB/telegram to check on availability of slot, and pay entry fee $20 in full to secure your slot. Your slot is not secured if payment is not made. Entry fee once paid, not refundable. 
Players to message us via the platforms below to register, check on availability and make payment. Telegram group link: https://t.me/+J6VaTyKFe-s2NzM1 
Our IG/Facebook: Happyland Collectibles 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/HappylandCollectibles 
IG: https://www.instagram.com/happyland_collectibles/

Thereafter, successfully registered players will need to register your decklist via the Omnidex before the event start latest by 1:15pm on event date or register your decklist 1 day before the event.
